name: What materials can you repair handrails for?

mainEntity.name: What materials can you repair handrails for?

acceptedAnswer.text: We repair handrails made from various materials, including wood (such as oak, maple, pine), metal (like wrought iron, steel, aluminum), and composite materials. Each material requires specific repair techniques and finishes to ensure durability and aesthetic integration with your existing structure.
acceptedAnswer.description: We repair handrails made of wood, metal (wrought iron, steel, aluminum), and composite materials.
